book.name: Matyiw
book.title: MATYIW Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Matyiw Tikak

content: Jiysis Bi Soy Ayndik Ayak Ak Gek Suŋ Ayak
Jiysis dum biyoŋ mindek ak kirgiy, mak biyaŋ apyowakniŋ, biynimb kuŋaynep kisen giyak.
Pen bi soy ayndik ayak bap, Jiysis mindek maŋ siŋak amiy, koŋgim yimiy, jiy kuyaŋgiy aŋgak, “Biyomb. Nand yip gey suŋ ayniŋg, gey suŋ ayniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, Jiysis nup diniŋyiŋg, “Nip suŋ ayaŋ aŋgak.” Aŋgek, won kun anep suŋ ayakniŋ aŋgak,

“Nip gen suŋ ayip kun ak, biynimb gunap kuyip ma aŋgñinimin. Am bi Gor nup simboŋgep gok kuyip nep yomiy, ‘Yip suŋ ayip aŋgnimin!’ Kun aŋgiy, Mosis aŋgak rek, yakir dam Gor nup pik simboŋg ñinimin. Kun geniŋgamban, biynimb gok niŋiy, nup suŋ ayip ak mey kun gisap aŋgniŋgambay aŋgak.”
Bi Amiybi Yomb Ak Nup Woŋg Giñiyiŋgip Ak Jiysis Gek Suŋ Ayak
Jiysis miñmon Kapaniyam amnakniŋ, amiybi gok kuyip kond mindyiŋgip biyomb bap ap Jiysis nup aŋgak,
“Bi yip woŋg gip anup tap yomb giy, yiwur nembnemb gek, kawin kaskas ma giy; korip ak kum mindip aŋgak.”
Aŋgek Jiysis aŋgak, “Am nup gen suŋ ayniŋgamb.”

Aŋgek amiy biyomb kun ak aŋgak, “Niŋind apan ak pen, yand bi tep rek korip yip ak amnimin. Yand niŋbiyn ak, amiy biyomb gunap yip kond mindey, yand pen amiybi gunap kuyip kond mindiy; amnimimb aŋgen, ambay sek; winimimb aŋgen, opay sek. Bi yip woŋg gip ak nup, woŋg gok kun kun giy ginimin aŋgen gip aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgek, Jiysis gos kuŋay yimb niŋiy, biynimb kisen ameyak gok kuyip aŋgak, “Bi kun biy par okok nimb ak pen, Gor gip rek niŋrep yimb giy kun aŋgip. Bi chin Yisrel nimb bap, Gor nup gosimb niŋiy aŋgip kun ak rek aŋgey, yand ma niŋnik.
Kisen biynimb par okok nimb gok, Ebraham, Aysek, Jekop biriwin yip Gor biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb namb ak amiy; miñmiñ giyiŋg mindeniŋgambay ak pen;
biynimb chin Yisrel nimb gok, am namb kun ak ma mindeniŋgambay rek ayip. Gor kuyip aŋgyokeniŋgamb, am mindeniŋgambay mis kisyim owip ar biyaŋ aŋgak.”
Jiysis kun aŋgiy, amiy biyomb kun anup aŋgak, “Nandkaw amnoŋ! Apan rek nep giniŋgamb aŋgak.” Kun aŋgek, korip amiy niŋak: binuk tap gak ak, Jiysis aŋgak won kun ak nep suŋ ayak.
Jiysis Piyta Numok Nup Gek Suŋ Ayak
Pen Jiysis Piyta korip amiy niŋak; Piyta numok nup mumbwak okok mon rek yinek kum mindek.
Niŋiy am diniŋek, won anep suŋ ayek tikjakiy, Jiysis binuk gok yip kuyip tap keñmaŋgiy gayrep gak.
Jiysis Biynimb Kuŋaynep Gek Suŋ Ayak
Duŋgep won ak, biynimb kichekiy ambaŋ ayak gok sek, biynimb tap gak gok sek dand Jiysis mindek ak apeyak, nuk kichekiy gok aŋg mis yokiy, biynimb tap gak gok gek suŋ ayak.
Nuk gak kun ak, bi Gor minim aŋgep Asaya, nind giniŋgamb aŋgiy tikak rek nep gak. Nuk tikiy aŋgak:

content.text: “Tap chinup gip gok gek suŋ ayniŋgamb. Tap yerip yerip chinup timey gip gok aŋgyokek mind tep giniŋgambun aŋgak.”

content: Yand Yip Taŋgoniŋgambur Aŋgak
Jiysis biynimb kuŋaynep ap nup piŋiy kus kus geyak niŋiy, binuk gok kuyip aŋgak, “Ñiŋg chemb kind bindoŋ amnun aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgakniŋ, bi low tiysa bap apiy nup aŋgak, “Tiysa. Nand miñmon akay akay amniŋgamban ak, yand yip nep amniŋgambur.”
Aŋgek Jiysis aŋgak, “Yakir gok, tip kiyk kinbay ak mindip. Kayn sakiy gok, man miŋgan okok kinbay; pen Bi bap Ñinuk kinimuŋ miŋgan ak ma mindip aŋgak.”
Pen bi Jiysis minim niŋyiŋgip bap aŋgak, “Yand nand yip amjur ak pen, yip yaw aŋgey, bapiy nup kumek komiy, nand yip giraŋgonjur.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Bi yip gosimb ma niŋbay gunap kumeniŋgiy, bi yip ma niŋbay gunap dam komniŋgiy; nand apey yand yip taŋgonjur aŋgak.”
Jiysis Aŋgek Yiŋgen Yomb Ak Kirgak
Jiysis bot diy amniŋg gek, binuk gok yip saŋdiyak.
Ñiŋg namb siŋak amniyakniŋ, day yiŋgen yomb sikerek ak diy, ñiŋg paŋg apiy, bot ak tuŋgandikniŋg rek gak. Pen Jiysis nuk kinek rek,
binuk gok am nup aŋgey tikjakek aŋgyak, “Biyomb! Yiŋgen yomb ak chinup tuŋgandikek ñiŋg ñiŋjun rek ayip ak, aŋgey kirgaŋ aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak kuyip aŋgak, “Yenen piriksipim? Gor nup gosimb ak ma niŋbim rek ayip!” Kun aŋgiy tikjakiy, yiŋgen dek ak aŋgek kirgiy, ñiŋg paŋg apek ak wilekiy gak.
Kun gek, kiyk gos kuŋay niŋiy, “Biyomb biy yergiy aŋgek, yiŋgen ak kirgiy, ñiŋg paŋg apamb ak kirgiy gip aŋgyak.”
Bi Malñiluk Sek Omiŋal Ak Jiysis Gek Bi Yimb Ayrik

Jiysis ñiŋg tikiy, miñmon Gadara pis bindoŋ amjakakniŋ, bi sakiy kichekiy ambaŋ ayak omiŋal ak, chip komyiŋgipay kamb miŋgan okok nimb apchakrik. Bi omiŋal kun ak kuyip kichekiy ambaŋ ayak rek, bi kilis yimb mindyiŋgipiyr. Biynimb bap mindyiŋgipiyr kinjeŋ tam kun ak ma amyiŋgipay.
Pen kiyk omiŋal apchakiy, Jiysis nup aŋgrik, “Gor Ñinuk! Chirup yerginiŋg aswan? Ñin nand chinup aŋg miñmon timey yokniŋgamban ak ma wip aŋgrik.”
Pen won kun ak, kanj kuŋaynep amil ñimbeyak yep gol kun siŋak ak mey,
kichekiy bi omiŋal kun ak kuyip abaŋ ayak gok, Jiysis nup nembnemb giyiŋg aŋgyak, “Chinup aŋgyokniŋg ginimin ak, aŋgey am kanj mindpay gindoŋ kuyip molik sikun aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, amnim aŋgek, bi omiŋal kun ak kuyip kirgiy, am kanj gok kuyip molik sikeyak; kanj gok pirik miñmon minduŋ pis okok amiy, gindam ñiŋg maŋgiy chemb biyaŋ pikiy, ñiŋg ñimbiy maŋgiysek kumdiyak.
Pen bi kanj mokyiŋgipay gok gak kun ak niŋiy, kasek miñmon dawin yomb ak amiy, Jiysis yerer gak minim ak, biynimb okok kuyip aŋgñiyak.
Aŋgñeyak kiyk maŋgiysek Jiysis nup niŋun aŋgiy, ap nup niŋiy, nembnemb giyiŋg aŋgyak, “Miñmon chinup biy kirgiy, key okok amnoŋ aŋgyak.”
